messages.subject: For Pierre Anjolras | Government relations, infrastructure and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Malek,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Pierre Anjolras, Chief Executive Officer.

VINCI's global infrastructure, concessions and energy-solutions portfolio requires disciplined alignment across governments, communities, sustainability commitments and operating teams. That interface closely matches the work I lead today inside a major multinational operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate senior institutional engagement and complex cross-functional matters across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and sustainability execution might support VINCI's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to VINCI.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
